run_model_evaluation: run the MMPreTrain test script to evaluate a model using a config file and checkpoint
test_with_amp: test a model with automatic mixed precision enabled using the --amp flag
test_with_tta: test a model with test-time augmentation enabled using the --tta flag
test_with_visualization: test a model and save visualization images to a specified output directory
test_with_custom_config: test a model by overriding config settings using the --cfg-options argument
